message.reasoning_content:
I will extract structured data from the invoice document.

I will parse the CSV and output JSON. I will not compute or infer values. Missing fields will be null.

Numbers will be plain values without currency symbols or separators. Dates will be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Invalid due dates become null and their original text goes into due_date_as_written. Misprints will be corrected to the intended value with a note. Each line item maps to one document line in order. Currency uses an ISO code when stated; otherwise null. Vendor is the party billing Acme, not Acme itself. Notes hold every free-text message verbatim.

I am extracting the invoice number, vendor, and dates. I am weighing whether due_date_as_written should capture the original text or remain null for a valid calendar date.

The due date is a valid calendar date. It will be reformatted to YYYY-MM-DD in the due_date field. The original text goes into due_date_as_written only when the date is not a calendar date.

The due date text is present. I will include it in due_date_as_written.

Currency is null. Three line items are extracted in document order: WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX. Subtotal, tax, and total lines are not line items.

Subtotal is 14750.00. Tax is 885.00. Shipping, payment terms, notes, revision, and corrections are null. The 6% is a label, not a separate field.
